relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.object: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
relations.role: William R. Kenan Jr., Distinguished Professor Emeritus of Islamic studies
relations.evidence: Carl W. Ernst (born September 8, 1950, in Los Angeles, California) is the William R. Kenan Jr., Distinguished Professor Emeritus of Islamic studies at the Department of Religious Studies at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.

relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.object: UNC Center for Islamic and Middle East Studies
relations.evidence: He was also the founding director (2003–2022) of the UNC Center for Islamic and Middle East Studies.

relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.evidence: Ernst received his A.B. in comparative religion at Stanford University in 1973

relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.evidence: and his Ph.D. at Harvard University in 1981.

relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.evidence: He taught at Pomona College from 1981 to 1992.

relations.subject: Carl W. Ernst
relations.object: Ecole des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales
relations.evidence: He has also been a visiting professor at the Ecole des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales (1990, 2003, 2019, 2022).
